questions.explanation: El pronombre means 'pronoun' — a word that stands in for a name.

questions.q: How do you conjugate ser for 'ellos' (they)?
questions.explanation: Ellos, ellas, and ustedes all take son: Ellos son altos.

questions.q: Which region uses vosotros for the informal 'you all'?
questions.explanation: Vosotros is used in Spain for informal 'you all' — this course uses ustedes instead.

questions.q: In Argentina and Uruguay, which word often replaces 'tú' for informal 'you' (one person)?
questions.explanation: Vos replaces tú in voseo regions, with its own conjugation — like 'vos sos' instead of 'tú eres.'

questions.q: Which form does THIS course use for 'you all,' in every lesson, regardless of formality?
questions.explanation: This course teaches Latin American Spanish, which uses ustedes for 'you all' in both formal and informal situations.
